notes: the sentence joins several routes with «و», «؛» and «جميعا»: the Ibn Abi Umayr / Ali ibn al-Hakam route closes on Hisham and is written; the Sa'd / Ya'qub pieces («محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد ابن الوليد»، «عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري» جميعا عن يعقوب) do not close into one route and are not written
«الحسن بن ظريف» is read as co-transmitter of أيوب بن نوح toward النضر: a doubtful reading of the «؛» punctuation
«رويته عن أبي» and «عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه» carry the compiler's father as a relation; the second is occurrence 2 of «أبي»
